body.name: Extended reciprocal image
body.construction: \(\Theta_{I,\delta}(b,q,\omega)=\{\rho_{11}(x,\omega)/\rho_{21}(x,\omega):x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega),\ \rho_{21}(x,\omega)>0\}\cup\{+\infty:\exists x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega),\ \rho_{21}(x,\omega)=0<\rho_{11}(x,\omega)\}\cup\bigl([0,+\infty]\text{ if }\exists x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega),\ \rho_{11}(x,\omega)=\rho_{21}(x,\omega)=0\bigr)\).
